author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (first-run)

prerequisites: Fresh unseeded lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-firstrun built from 3fa407e3, with its own Mailpit. The fictional first Administrator is DOC-029 first-run Avery Morgan.

Three lab lifecycles with the same app and engine image IDs: one for the full path to Finish, one for the email phases, and one for Skip optional steps. Completion is one-way, so each finishing action needs its own instance.
Email phases recreate only app and worker with email-unset.overlay.json or email-from-missing.overlay.json from the batch folder.
A local OpenID Connect stand-in (oidc-fixture.mjs) on the lab backend network for Register provider.
scenarios.expected: The Administrator reaches the app and the saved settings reflect the completed steps. Validation/retry and resumed onboarding work. The nine-step wizard, the Setup checklist, and Review behave as the article states.
scenarios.actual: 46 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3. Set up OpenLaw refused a seven-character password and showed "The passwords do not match."; the corrected form signed the Administrator in at Welcome to OpenLaw, Step 1 of 9, and setup then redirected to Sign in and the API answered 409. Your organization offered only English (United States), refused a GIF and a 300 KB PNG, accepted a small PNG, and Continue saved name, logo and Europe/Lisbon. Authentication refused a policy with no method ("Enable at least one sign-in method."), kept Single sign-on (SSO) disabled until Register provider showed a callback URL, and Require two-factor authentication forced enrollment; after a TOTP code the wizard reopened at Welcome with the saved choices. Business-user portal saved two bare domains and the magic-link switch; an address was refused. Set up later on Your organization, Authentication, Business-user portal and Invite your team saved nothing unsaved. Reload returned to Welcome with saved settings. An environment relay made Outbound email read-only; SMTP_URL without SMTP_FROM showed the SMTP_FROM warning; with email unset every app page opened the wizard, Skip optional steps opened Outbound email, Continue stayed disabled and there was no Set up later until Save relay, and Send test email delivered. Send invite delivered Legal team member and Administrator invitations. E-signature and AI analysis Set up later left both connectors unconfigured. Review showed nine list counts and three reminder offsets; Finish recorded the review and opened Home, and /welcome then redirected Home. Set up later on Review and Skip optional steps with email configured each ended onboarding without the review. The Setup checklist linked each row to its Settings page, showed Email without a link, and Mark as reviewed removed Review seeded types.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author. It is not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

Single sign-on was checked only as far as Register provider, the callback URL, and the SSO switch becoming available, against a local OpenID Connect stand-in. No SSO sign-in was run and no real identity provider was used.
E-signature and AI analysis were only skipped. Connecting DocuSign or an AI provider is out of scope here and belongs to the connector guides.

The Email row of the Setup checklist can only show after completion, because before completion an unconfigured email sends every page to the wizard. It was seen by removing SMTP_FROM from the environment after completion (phase B2).

The email phases reused the instance from the failed first phase A attempt, whose Administrator already existed; phase B0 signed in instead of using the first-account form. The first-account form was checked on the two other fresh instances.
Invitation delivery was checked by Mailpit recipient and subject only. Invitation activation and Business User entry, which the article leaves to later checks, were not exercised.
Contextual Help on Set up OpenLaw and the wizard was not rechecked in this round.

The first phase A attempt failed on a reviewer script fault (an ambiguous combobox locator). Its record is kept in walkthrough-r1.json with its disposition; phase A was rerun in full on a new lab and passed.
